title: Rehabilitation of Ogere Water Supply Scheme
client: World Bank / Ogun State Water Corporation
summary: Sato completes and handover the rehabilitation of Ogere Water Scheme in Ogun State, a World Bank financed project. During the handing over ceremony, the Head Project implementation Unit of the Ogun State Water Corporation, Engr. Maku, commended the company for a job well done.
scope: Rehabilitation of the intake structure, filters, aerators, sedimentation tanks and Buildings.
Designing and construction of over-head tanks.
Designing and developing of state of the art electro-mechanical systems.
Construction of over-head tanks, clear water tanks, flocculation chamber and staff quarters.
Laying of several kilometres of Ductile iron pipes.

title: Channelization of Lower Awba Stream
location: University of Ibadan Zoological Garden, Oyo State
summary: Sato has been awarded contract for the channelization of the Lower Awba Stream at the University of Ibadan. The project is to put an end to the perennial flooding along the axis of the Awba Stream from the source to the Dam. The scope involves establishing horizontal alignment and setting out as designed excavating trench using profile levels and making good the excavation to receive concrete. Reinforcement bars of different sizes are to be bent and placed in line with project working drawings and concrete works to form the shape specified for the Channelization works.
